title: LichenFrame serializer does not enforce its declared field types
description: Correctness/type-contract review of python/src/lichen/link/frame.py found _validate only exact-checks mic_length. Values such as epoch=True or seqnum=True are accepted as counters; floats can pass range checks and later raise AttributeError at to_bytes(); a non-AddrMode addr_mode fails through an incidental attribute error; and non-bool signature_present/encrypted values are treated by truthiness. This yields exceptions outside FrameError and permits noncanonical caller state despite a protocol serializer API. Validate exact AddrMode, bool flags, exact int epoch/seqnum excluding bool, and bytes fields before arithmetic/serialization; add exhaustive invalid-type tests and retain FrameError (or a clearly documented TypeError contract) consistently.
